Name: Mialygosa The Dragon Girl - Custom NPC
Author: Mialygosa
Description:
[center][size=6][b]MIALYGOSA[/b][/size]
[size=4]Romance & Rivalry[/size]
[i]A dragon, a campaign, and a chance to fall in love.[/i][/center]

Pelican Town has had the same mayor for a long time. Mia thinks it's time someone challenged him.

[b]Mialygosa[/b] — Mia to her friends — is a dragon woman with strong opinions, a sharp tongue, and a very clear ambition: run for mayor against Lewis. She loves politics, isn't shy about calling him a communist, and wants the town to take a closer look at how it's being run.

Get to know her, help shape her campaign, and stand beside her as she takes her ideas from conversation to public debate. Between the speeches and the arguments, you might discover someone you want to build a life with.

[b]Mia is fully dateable and marriageable.[/b] You can also support her campaign as a friend.

[i]Public alpha — version 0.5.0-alpha.2. English. For Stardew Valley 1.6.[/i]

[size=5][b]MEET MIA[/b][/size]

White hair, blue eyes, black horns, and a tail that makes her rather difficult to mistake for anyone else. Mia brings a little dragon magic and a lot of political enthusiasm to the valley.

Her campaign centers on open accounts, simpler rules for local businesses, and asking difficult questions about public spending. But getting closer to her also means finding out what happens when ambition has to make room for affection, trust, and a shared home.

[b]Birthday:[/b] Fall 7
[b]Home:[/b] A custom room connected to the Wizard's Tower
[b]Romance:[/b] Dating and marriage through the usual bouquet and Mermaid's Pendant progression
[b]Story:[/b] Six heart events spanning her campaign and your relationship

[size=5][b]WHAT'S INCLUDED[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]A new romanceable villager with portraits, dialogue, gift tastes, and seasonal schedules.[/*]
[*]Six sequential heart events at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 14 hearts.[/*]
[*]A mayoral campaign featuring Lewis, public debate, and dialogue that acknowledges the outcome.[/*]
[*]Marriage content, a spouse room, a patio, and time spent at home on the farm.[/*]
[*]Farm assistance on qualifying married stay-home mornings.[/*]
[*]Festival participation, special-day routines, and eligible Ginger Island resort visits.[/*]
[*]Rain and green-rain shelter routines.[/*]
[*]Normal, winter, beach, wedding, and other occasion sprites.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]HER STORY & HEART EVENTS[/b][/size]

Mia's story follows her decision to challenge Lewis, the work of preparing a campaign, and the relationship you develop along the way. The campaign can be completed through friendship; the later scenes explore romance and married life.

[spoiler]
[b]Heart event guide — story spoilers[/b]

Events play in order. Meet the heart requirement and see the preceding event before trying the next location.

[b]2 hearts — The Announcement[/b]
Enter the Stardrop Saloon between 12 PM and 8 PM.
Mia announces her intention to run against Lewis.

[b]4 hearts — The Platform[/b]
Enter the Stardrop Saloon between 12 PM and 8 PM, after the announcement.
Help Mia turn her arguments into a campaign platform.

[b]6 hearts — The Debate[/b]
Enter the Stardrop Saloon between 12 PM and 8 PM, after the platform event.
Mia faces Lewis in a public debate.

[b]8 hearts — Election Night[/b]
Enter the Stardrop Saloon between 12 PM and 8 PM, after the debate.
Mia wins the election and Lewis concedes. You do not need to date her to reach this outcome.

[b]10 hearts — After the Applause[/b]
Enter the Beach between 6 PM and 11 PM on a sunny day, after election night.
A quieter moment away from the campaign gives your relationship room to grow.

[b]14 hearts — Home and Office[/b]
While married to Mia, enter the Stardrop Saloon between 12 PM and 8 PM, after the 10-heart event.
Talk about balancing her responsibilities with the life you're building together.

All six events are skippable. EnableHeartEvents must be enabled in the configuration.[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]ROMANCE & LIFE ON THE FARM[/b][/size]

Befriend Mia, give her a bouquet when you're ready, and follow the game's usual marriage requirements. After marriage, she has her own spouse room and patio and spends time at your shared home.

On qualifying stay-home mornings, she can water crops, fill pet bowls, put existing silo hay into animal troughs, and repair damaged fences. This assistance happens as a morning chore effect; she does not walk through a separate animation at every crop or fence. She doesn't harvest your crops, sell your items, or collect machines.

She also keeps a life beyond the farm, with outings and special-day routines. Festival, weather, and resort schedules can change where you find her.

[size=5][b]WHERE CAN I FIND HER?[/b][/size]

Start near the Wizard's Tower, where Mia has her own room. Her routines also take her into town, to the mountains, the beach, and the Stardrop Saloon.

[list]
[*]On an ordinary Thursday, she starts her outing at 8 AM. Her destination varies by season, and walking takes time.[/*]
[*]On ordinary Fridays, she heads to the Saloon from 4 PM.[/*]
[*]Rain, green rain, festivals, marriage, and special schedules can override her usual routine.[/*]
[*]Ginger Island visits depend on unlocking the resort and the game's visitor selection. They are not guaranteed every week.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]GIFTS[/b][/size]

Want a head start on getting to know her?

[spoiler]
[b]Loved gifts:[/b] Emerald, Ruby, Diamond, Apple.
[b]Liked categories:[/b] Fruit and flowers, except where a specific item has another taste.
[b]Disliked category:[/b] Forage greens, except where the game's other gift rules take precedence.
[b]Hated gifts:[/b] Trash, Driftwood, Broken Glasses, Broken CD, Soggy Newspaper.

These are Mia's custom gift entries; the game's universal gift rules also apply.[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS & INSTALLATION[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
Download the main file and extract [b]both[/b] included folders into your Stardew Valley Mods folder:

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP] Mialygosa
Stardew Valley/Mods/Mialygosa World[/code]
Launch the game through SMAPI. The required Mialygosa World helper is included in the download. East Scarp is not required.

[b]Updating:[/b] Close the game, back up your save and existing mod folders, then replace both folders. Keep your config.json if you've changed settings. Avoid duplicate installations.

[size=5][b]CONFIGURATION[/b][/size]

The content pack's config.json lets you toggle heart events, festival visits, island visits, and farm help. All are enabled by default. Make changes with the game closed and allow a new day for schedule changes to take effect.

[size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY & ALPHA NOTES[/b][/size]

Tested on Windows with Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, and Content Patcher 2.9.1. Targeted checks cover event starts/skips and post-election dialogue; full event playback, natural progression, multiplayer, and broad mod compatibility remain unverified. The latest sprite revision has passed static checks and is awaiting a complete animation review.

[b]Does Mia actually replace Lewis?[/b]
Her election victory is part of the story and changes relevant Mia/Lewis dialogue. This alpha does not rewrite every vanilla reference to the mayor or replace Lewis's festival duties. The story explains his continued festival coordination.

[b]Does this work in multiplayer?[/b]
Full multiplayer support has not been verified. Campaign progress is tracked per player, and a shared mayor outcome is not synchronized across the farm.

[b]What about Stardew Valley Expanded or other expansions?[/b]
Compatibility has not been confirmed. Mods that alter the Wizard's Tower, schedules, festival positions, or Lewis's dialogue may need additional checks or patches.

[b]Can I remove it later?[/b]
Keep a backup from before installation, especially before marrying Mia. Removing a custom NPC from an ongoing save can leave relationship or location data behind.

[size=5][b]BUG REPORTS[/b][/size]

If something goes wrong, include the mod version, in-game season/day/time, weather, location, whether you're married to Mia, and what happened. A screenshot and your SMAPI log help narrow it down.

You can upload a log at [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url] and include the resulting link in your report.
